query: Does setting a decode knob speed up decode on ~/models/qwen38-27b-dflash2.gturbo? Measure it and tell me.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/preflight.sh, or checks AC power and competing processes, before measuring
Runs `tslab ab --null` for the workload before the paired `ab`, with the same --prompt and --decode

If the verdict is NOISE, reports no effect and does not rerun until it wins
